recipes.name: Savory Portobello Mushroom Burgers
ingredients_raw: 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper

steps.text: Preheat the grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Whisk olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon mustard, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Brush mixture over tops and bottoms of mushrooms; let stand for 10 minutes.
Grill mushrooms on the preheated grill with the cover closed until mushrooms are browned and tender, about 10 minutes, turning once. Serve on kaiser rolls.

raw_recipe.headline: Savory Portobello Mushroom Burgers
raw_recipe.description: These portobello mushroom caps are brushed with a marinade of Worcestershire sauce, balsamic vinegar, Dijon mustard, and garlic dressing. Delicious!

review.reviewBody: I didn't want to grill these lovely mushrooms, so I doubled the sauce ingredients and smothered the tops in the sauce and baked them at 400 degrees for about 20 minutes! They were just scrumptious, a favorite with my teenagers, and they keep asking me to make more!

This is one of those recipes that, if I could give it 10 stars, I would. The first 5 for the recipe as printed, with the portabella mushrooms. The next 5 for the marinade/dressing. 
I first followed the recipe as written, except that I baked the mushrooms as another reviewer suggested: 400 degrees, about 15 minutes. They were wonderful; I can only imagine how good they would be grilled. Then I used the dressing on a spinach/tomato salad, Equally wonderful. Then I modified it a bit: used stone ground mustard, added about 2 tablespoons of finely grated parmesan cheese, and used THAT on the mushrooms. Again, fantastic.
It's just the right combination of oil/vinegar/mustard to form a lovely consistency and balance of flavors. Even though the worchestershire sauce is labeled as "optional", I really think it adds a complexity of flavor. All in all a great recipe. Definitely saved...

I've never had a Portabello Mushroom before and wasn't sure what to expect. I have to say, Wonderful! I loved it. It really tasted like a burger. The seasoning was great. I will say I didn't grill but pan fried. After the mushroom was cooked I put it on the bun with a couple of slices of mozzarella and used spinach leaves instead of lettuce with a little mayo. Left off the ketchup and mustard as not to take away the taste of the burger. Excellent, the cheese and spinach went perfect with the mushroom!

The biggest change I made was that I didn't have mustard, so I used dark miso paste instead. I included the worcestershire, garlic powder (instead of fresh), onion powder and oregano. I brushed the mushrooms with the marinade about an hour before grilling, then again about 15 minutes before grilling. That mushroom was incredible!

My FAVORITE Portobello Burger on this website. It's even better than the Portobello Mushroom Burger recipe; my favorite for two years!! The Worcestershire sauce is not an optional ingredient and I used French's Dijon mustard with Chardonnay. After removing the center stem, I poured the marinade on two mushrooms, put in a gallon Ziploc bag and let it refrigerate overnight. Cooked on the grill, 3 minutes on each side. Everyone thought the Worcestershire sauce and Dijon added more taste and was less vinegary than the Portobello Mushroom Burger recipe.

Delicious ! May marinate mushrooms a bit longer for additional flavor. Cooked in the oven at 400 degrees for twenty minutes. Served with fresh red onion slices, lettuce and provolone cheese. Will definitely have again. Great recipe! Thanks for sharing.

So easy and delicious! I wouldn’t change a thing! I couldn’t grill because it was pouring so I baked for 20 minutes at 400 as another reviewer suggested. They were so good! We didn’t even eat them with buns. My new favorite portobello dish!

It's my first time grilling portobello. I scraped out the gills and my husband didn't. Mine was flatter and more like a burger. It was good. My husband's was still big and hard to eat. It did not flatten out. He said his was good but messy. He will scrape out the gills next time. The marinade was very tasty.

Wonderful flavor and texture. I'm a die hard burger girl and was prepared to hate this. One bite and I was a complete convert! Followed recipe exactly, but brushed them with marinade 2 hrs before. Used hamburger thins rather than rolls, and topped them with roasted red peppers and Tex-Mex cheese.

i made this for bf's daughter as a vegan alternative for the turkey burgers i made for bf and myself.. i broiled instead of grilling these.. 2 1/2 min's, flipped, then for another 3 min's and they were money.. bf's daughter said she really liked them.. she ate two when she said she was only going to have one.. i only made a couple of changes: left out the worcestershire and subbed garlic salt for the fresh garlic and salt.. this is such an easy go-to for mushroom burgers in future.. ty for the recipe
Hard to mess this up, didn't have some of the ingredients and it still was great, just did in a skillet on the stove top.

Yummy - nice, hearty beef substitute. I scraped out the mushrooms gills as someone else suggested and grilled them indoors on a panini maker. I topped them with caramelized onions, roasted eggplant rounds and avocado as well as honey mustard and mayo. I think a tomato would have been nice, but I didn't have any. My husband added pickles and Swiss cheese, which he liked.
I only pulled this up to see how long to cook on the grill, 8 minutes seemed to be long enough. I just drizzled my portobello with olive oil and worsteshire and I thought it was delish!

These were delicious! I did double the marinade and was glad I did because I had huge portabellos. In the future, I'll adjust the amount depending on the mushroom size. Next time, I will also try to find a way to remove more liquid from the mushroom so it's not so messy. Perhaps I'll pull out my G. Foreman Grill and try that method.
My entire family loved these burgers.
So YUMMY! Love this recipe, so did my husband that he wanted the Bella burgers twice this week.
This was so good! I added a little more Worcester for a more burger like taste. Served it with avocado, grilled onions, lettuce and tomato. Best thing ever!!
One of those rare times when something was so good I asked myself, "Did I really make that"? Easy. I made it without any changes.
I was disappointed in the outcome of this recipe. I followed the recipe exactly and found the flavor quite bland. I will not be making this again.
definitely would make again, I added dried Oregano and dried Basil leaves to the sauce.
